text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, well, about what I expected.
They had plenty of grit, just like the rumors said, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So what does it matter? Even without some
special strategy, I can run just fine.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: ââ!! Wha, this is...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Her form is still unrefined. But this girl... knows how to race!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ha, of course.
I've been brawling freelance since way before I entered Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't know nothin' about running with good manners,
but when it comes to an all-out brawl, that's my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
See, Trainer?
Told you there was nothing to worry about, right?

Jungle Pocket understood racing
not with her head, but with her body...

Even in her Twinkle Series debut race,
the experience from her wild days seemed to serve her well.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
So it's not merely reckless abandon.
In fact, quite the opposite...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Overthinking it and exposing my own shallowness...
that was entirely on me. I couldn't bring out my true ability at all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Don't look so down, Tsuzuki.
Your running was way better than before, too."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Well, even so, the one who's gonna take down that Tachyon—
is gonna be me."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Ngh—shut your mouth. The one who will surpass Tachyon
is me. And besides—

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Running purely on instinct will only get you so far.
As I thought... you and I are completely incompatible.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I thought you were the one person I'd never see eye to eye with.
We do things in completely opposite ways, after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Then—let's tear each other apart.
Before we face Tachyon in the Classic Triple Crown, that is!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Heh...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heheh...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, good work today.
Now, about what's next—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I wanna run against Tachyon next.
Where's she showing up?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, the real showdown is next year. But before that,
we gotta throw down a little greeting first."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The big races she's likely to show up in are...
choice_data_list: Agnes Tachyon Hasn't Raced Yet, Though

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if she'll make it in time
for the big races at this rate, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: She'll still show up. I just know it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: She's not like Tsuzuki. She has the brains to devise an absolute strategy, and the legs to pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"She's sharpening her fangs in the shadows somewhere right now.
All to be ready in time for the year-end G1."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Give me your assessment. Which Junior-class
GⅠ best suits Tachyon's aptitudes?"
choice_data_list: I think the most promising option is the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.text:
The Hopeful Stakes.
A 2000m G1 held at Nakayama Racecourse
at the end of the year.

The other Junior GⅠ races are 1600m mile events.
With Agnes Tachyon's sharp burst of speed, she'll likely target a medium-distance race, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
All right, if you say so,
I'll believe ya. Then next is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Let's aim for the Hopeful Stakes.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't want the "Asahi Hai FS"?
Are you okay with not doing the "Asahi Hai FS"?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —!? The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes?! You mean...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's my partner for you.
You can see right through how I feel, huh?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's the G1 that Fuji Kiseki won, after all.
Yeah, it's the GⅠ that Fuji Kiseki won, after all.

text_block_list.text:
I understand the desire to walk the same path
as the Umamusume you respect. However...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about the Asahi Hai FS.
Fuji-san won that race, after all.
More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep an eye on Tachyon and
prepare for next year's Classic Triple Crown,
the one Fuji-san couldn't run in.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Rather than the past where I won, it's about the future where I failed to.
choice_data_list: Got it. Then let's do that!

text_block_list.text:
"If Jungle Pocket has decided so,
then there's no problem. The next goal is――"

The year-end Hopeful Stakes.
But will Agnes Tachyon really be able to run?
